description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint class for listing catalog types in the eShopWeb application. It includes route setup and an async handler method that retrieves catalog type entities from a repository, maps them to DTOs, and returns the response.

classes.name: CatalogTypeListEndpoint
classes.description: A minimal API endpoint class responsible for handling HTTP GET requests to list catalog types, utilizing dependency injection for mapping and repository services.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Defines the GET route 'api/catalog-types' and associates it with an async handler that retrieves catalog types from the repository.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Performs the asynchronous retrieval of catalog types, maps entities to DTOs, constructs the response, and returns an HTTP 200 OK result.
